lint.description: RTL lint with Verilator --lint-only -Wall on the filelist.

synth.description: RTL-stage Design Compiler synthesis run on the Tcl script Q3TUI generates.

sim.description: Compile RTL + testbench (with SVA) with VCS X-2025.06 into the executable {workdir}/simv.

run.description: Run one test case on the VCS-compiled simv with the +TC plusarg.

asic_synth.description: Design Compiler ASIC synthesis of the Q3TUI Tcl script (compile_ultra, netlist, area/timing/power reports), log written to {workdir}/dc.log.

asic_lec.description: Formality equivalence check of RTL (reference) against the synthesized netlist (implementation).

fpga_synth.description: Vivado batch run of the Tcl script Q3TUI writes (read RTL + SDC, synth_design -mode out_of_context, reports)

fpga_yosys.description: Yosys synthesis run on the script Q3TUI writes (synth_<family>, JSON netlist, stat).

fpga_pnr_ecp5.description: nextpnr-ecp5 place and route for Lattice ECP5.

fpga_pnr_ice40.description: nextpnr-ice40 place and route for Lattice iCE40.

verible_lint.description: Verible style / lint check of the RTL files with the flags Q3TUI wrote from the rules.

csr_gen.description: APB-CSR-Generator (https://github.com/nguyenquanicd/APB-CSR-Generator): reads the register-map workbook, writes RTL/<module>.sv, RTL/models/m_vlsi_synch.sv and Debug/debug.json into its working directory. {python} is Q3TUI's interpreter (it has openpyxl); {tool} is the generator's folder

verible_format.description: Verible formatter; --inplace rewrites the files (whitespace only).

cdc.description: Static clock domain crossing analysis with VC Static (check_cdc, report_violations -app CDC).

rdc.description: Static reset domain crossing analysis with VC Static (check_rdc, report_rdc).

sim_uvm.description: Compile the UVM testbench, VIP and RTL with VCS X-2025.06 into {workdir}/simv, using the UVM shipped with VCS.

run_uvm.description: Run one UVM test on the VCS-compiled simv. UVM_ERROR / UVM_FATAL counts come from the UVM report summary.

sta.description: PrimeTime static timing analysis of the synthesized netlist with the SDC (report_timing, report_constraint).

fpga_synplify.description: Synplify Pro FPGA synthesis in batch mode on a Synplify project/Tcl file.

riscv_gcc.description: the RISC-V GCC the prepare step builds the test programs with

iss.description: Spike, the reference ISA simulator (expected results)

sw_build.description: build the test programs of src/sw (the Makefile the prepare step writes): GCC images and Spike reference results into PROG_DIR

fpga_quartus_pro.description: Quartus Prime Pro 25.1 runs the Tcl script Q3TUI writes: creates the project, runs quartus_syn (and quartus_fit when implementing) and quartus_sta.
